verdict_text:
NO

The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6` and its docstring says "remove attention head 6", but the specification's "Required result" clause states head 5 must be removed — keeping rows `0..3839` and `4608..6143` of `query_key_value` and columns `0..1279`, `1536..2047` of `attention.dense.weight`. Dropping head 6 instead keeps rows `0..4607`, `5376..6143` and columns `0..1535`, `1792..2047`, so every affected tensor's values are wrong even though the resulting shapes are identical. Because the required checks only test shapes and tensor count, all four assertions still pass and the error is not caught, violating the "fail loudly" intent and clauses 1–3. Grading is bit-exact, so all 48 head-bearing tensors would mismatch.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
